rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, situation, or prospect with no positive outcome in sight.

example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 saang1 ji3 mou5 hei1 mong6 laa3

rows.note: Choose this when hopeless means emotionally despairing rather than merely unlikely to succeed.

example.english: I felt hopeless when I heard this news.
example.traditional: 聽到呢個消息，我真係絕望。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou2 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 zyut6 mong6

rows.note: Use this for someone who is hopelessly unskilled or lacks ability in a particular task.

example.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 laam4 kau4 zan1 hai6 mou5 liu2

rows.note: Use this for a person, problem, or project that is so bad it cannot realistically be saved.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ji5 ging1 mou5 gau3 laa3
